findings.title: Keep the registered metric alert handler instantiable
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits StatefulDetectorHandler but does not implement its abstract counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, or build_occurrence_and_event_data members. It remains registered as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, so accessing detector.detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire detector now raises TypeError instead of returning the previous no-op handler. process_detectors does not catch this exception, so that detector also prevents subsequent detectors from being processed. Implement the required members or retain a concrete no-op handler until the stateful implementation is ready.

findings.title: Build the expected occurrence for the group key being evaluated
findings.body: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence using group key "val1", but calls evaluate_group_key_value with "group_key". The occurrence builder includes that key in the fingerprint, so the expected occurrence has fingerprint '<detector id>:val1' while the actual occurrence has '<detector id>:group_key'. This is an inconsistent expected result for the new hook and fails when occurrence equality compares fingerprints. Build the expected occurrence with "group_key" so the test validates the occurrence actually requested by the evaluation.
